title: Concept: Dependency declared with RubyGems range syntax
description: package.json declares a `~>` range, which is RubyGems syntax rather than npm syntax, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: npm resolves the text as an unknown comparator or a tag, so the install either fails or follows a reference nobody reviewed.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: npm resolves the text as an unknown comparator or a tag, so the install either fails or follows a reference nobody reviewed.
